name: Tip the Balance
body:
Tip the Balance (Su) [Any Lord of Equilibrium]
Source Mythic Origins pg. 9
As a swift action, you can expend one use of mythic power to make your weapons, natural weapons, and unarmed strikes count as any alignment needed to overcome a foe's alignment-based damage reduction for 1 minute per tier. During this time, your alignment also counts as the most favorable possible for spells or effects that are based on alignment.
6th-Tier Godling Path Abilities
You must be at least 6th tier to select these path abilities.
